limitations: Native LM/scalar feature scores are not independently recomputed by this numeric auditor; it verifies the pinned native exact-score gate receipt and one covered row per pre candidate.
Pinned build executable/compiler/runtime/dependency/source members are independently SHA256-checked as inert bytes; no build member is executed or imported.
Image before/after hashes are compared as pinned declarations; image bytes are never opened by this auditor.
Candidate support is a pre/post consolidation diagnostic, not a recovered TP, precision/recall measurement or speed improvement.
